name: Anvil Player Heads
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: crimulus
description: Adds the ability to rename a minecraft:player_head in an anvil and update it to the corresponding player's skin. Requires a way to acquire the player_head object. I use a custom recipe to craft zombie_head → player_head.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers. Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln development build 2026-11-25 (8dfda948) (22 classes, 35 members). Not run yet.
